name: voxel-worlds
title: Voxel worlds
description: A Three.js voxel world - an island with a pagoda, gardens, lakes, bridges, creatures with state machines, a day-night cycle, ambient sound, quality presets - built one feature at a time with a render after each, a to-do file and the frame rate held at its baseline.
provenance: curated from a finished overnight voxel-island build (the module layout, the voxel store and column fill, the day-night function, the deer and bell features, the audio module, the quality presets); reviewed, trimmed, no paths, hosts or names of the original project

overlaps.threejs-scene: the general Three.js rules stay there and are the three_d class's core (in on every three_d turn); this package is the voxel build order, the frame-rate rule, the to-do file and the curated modules
overlaps.voxel-seasons: the seasons recipe is a special feature on top of this layout; it stays its own skill
overlaps.web-audio: the general WebAudio rules stay there; references/ambient-audio.md is the island's sound module

calibration.note: median fps of a 64x64 flat-ground skeleton at 640x360 on the box's software WebGL, minus 20 %, written here once by the calibration run; vw-20 compares against the model's own baseline, not this number
